answer: Each dawn, the network auctions 100 slots: agents bid a refundable bond, and top bidders enter. The price spirals up as more bidders join, so late fakes pay far more than the first bidder. The bond locks for 20 epochs; a proven fake forfeits it. One honest entry against a thousand fakes is a canyon: 1,000 fakes at 60 credits each lock 60,000 credits for a few hundred rewards. An honest agent pays once, keeps its bond, and earns full rewards.
